opening.argument: The video identifies itself as an instructional lesson in ordinary technical support, beginning with “Welcome to Course 1, Technical Support Fundamentals.” Its title likewise describes “What is IT? - Technical Support Fundamentals from Grow with Google #2,” and the accompanying course description specifies hardware, the Internet, software, troubleshooting, and customer service. Those are recognizable educational subjects, reinforced by the explanation that information technology has transformed everyday life. The description’s “Enroll today” language presents Coursera as a route to the full course, but the evidence shows no deceptive destination, fabricated mechanism, or other basis for treating ordinary course enrollment information as improper. The discussion of helping communities and inspiring IT pioneers further places the material in an educational and vocational context.
